eps.ov: Grid hopes to strike it rich in the VR game Satisfy. While taking on an S-Ranked quest, he discovers Pagma’s Tome.

eps.t: First Step Towards Being a Blacksmith
eps.ov: Grid has made a fresh start. With nowhere else to turn, he begins learning the fundamentals of blacksmithing.
The Mero Company sends Huroi, an Orator, to the village. There, he forcibly triggers a hidden quest...!?
Grid faces Euphemina in a blacksmithing contest. The contest turns into an S-Ranked quest to rescue Huroi.
Grid continues his blacksmithing. He puts up an epic armor for auction, and gets a request for more.
Grid goes with Khan to visit his son's grave. He gets a new job quest: to learn "Pagma's Sword Dance."
Grid heads to Kesan Canyon for his job quest. On the way, he meets his old bullies from the real world.
Grid is asked to make the Divine Shield. He completes it, but the Yatan Church steals it.
Grid fights in a raid against Malaxus. Malaxus is almost defeated when he turns the tide with powerful magic…
